verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS meeting-notes product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Recording pause/resume, retention policies, and workspace API/MCP enablement are adjacent data-governance controls, not a telemetry opt-out, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
